description:
Performance-focused titanium gravel. Exceptional value.
Discover the Enigma Edge MK.I, a titanium gravel bike designed for riders who enjoy pushing the pace, tackling challenging terrain and making the most of every gravel ride. Combining responsive handling, all-day comfort and the unmistakable ride quality of titanium, the Edge is equally at home on fast gravel routes, rough tracks and mixed-surface rides.
Built around a beautifully finished 3Al/2.5V titanium frame and equipped with Shimano GRX 11-speed mechanical 1x shifting, DT Swiss wheels and a C-Six carbon fork, the Edge delivers an excellent balance of performance, control and versatility.
SAVE 32% – WAS £4,870, NOW £3,399
With the Edge now succeeded by the Enigma Eremos, we're offering this remaining Edge MK.I at a saving of £1,471. Brand new and unused, complete with a full Enigma warranty.

Size & Availability
56cm – Only one available.
Once it's gone, it's gone.
An exceptional opportunity to own an Enigma titanium gravel bike equipped with Shimano GRX mechanical 1x shifting, saving £1,471 against its original retail price. Limited to this single 56cm Edge MK.I, while stocks last.
